question: Identify the element that is NOT a metalloid.
solution:
The correct answer is** Sodium**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** Metalloid:- It is a chemical element that consists of properties of **metal and non-metals.**

__
 
• **There are 6 metalloids in the modern periodic table.**
 
• These 6 metalloids are:-**Boron (B), Silicon (Si), Germanium (Ge), Arsenic (As), Antimony (Sb), and Tellurium (Te).**
 
• Their other physical properties and chemical properties are **intermediate in nature mostly**.
 
• They look like metal but they can **behave like non-metal chemically.**
 
• They can form **alloys with metals**
 
• Generally, they are **fair conductors of electricity.**
 
• They are **lustrous in appearance.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sodium **is a **soft metal** having a **silvery white color.**
 
• It is a **good conductor of electricity and heat.**
 
• Its **atomic number is 11**
 
• It is used in the **purification of hydrocarbons, perfume and detergents.**
